info.title: The Living Bread (read only)
info.description: Read-only public doors of The Living Bread (living-bread.org): Scripture read from the stored King James Version, verification of a quoted verse, crisis lines by country, grounded answers from the knowledge graph, real churches and public gatherings, and the live count of people who prayed. No account, no write, no personal data. Directory data CC BY 4.0, attribute The Living Bread (living-bread.org); Scripture public domain.

get.summary: Emergency number and crisis line for the person's country. Call FIRST when anyone is in danger or speaks of harming themselves or others.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, as the person said it. If unknown, ask the person; never assume a country.

200.description: found true with emergency numbers and crisis_line (with source and verified_at), or found false with the general rule and the countries held

get.summary: A Bible passage read verbatim from the stored King James Version (public domain). Use for every verse you quote.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: A reference such as John 3:16, Psalm 23:1-6 or Romans 8:38-39 (URL encoded), or a slug like john-3-16. At most 31 verses from one chapter.

200.description: ref, verses [{ verse, text }], text, translation, urn

get.summary: Check whether words are really Scripture before presenting them as a quotation: verbatim, close_but_differs (with a word diff), resembles, or not_found in any held translation. Returns the closest real verse with reference and SHA-256.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: The exact words to check, 3 to 2000 characters.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: The reference the words are attributed to, e.g. Philippians 4:13.

parameters.name: translations
parameters.description: Comma separated held translations, default KJV, at most 3 (for example KJV,es,de).

200.description: verdict, verdict_sentence, best_match { ref, translation, text, verses [{ ref, text, sha256 }], diff }, claimed_check, differences, not_found, source_url

get.summary: Grounded answer from The Living Bread knowledge graph: real denominations, saints, sacred sites, people and places of the Bible the question names, the church directory and its true count when a country is named, a related page, and next steps. Never invents; empty when nothing grounds.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The question in the person's words.

200.description: question, entities, churches, scripture, road_to_christ, next_steps

get.summary: Real churches in the open directory nearest a point in a country, sorted by distance.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country slug, lower case with hyphens, e.g. kenya, south-korea, united-kingdom.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the place the person named.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude of the place the person named.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1 to 50, default 20.

parameters.name: denomination
parameters.description: Optional denomination filter (substring).

200.description: churches with name, denomination, distance, stable lb: id and page

get.summary: One church in the open directory.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country slug, e.g. colombia.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Church slug from a previous answer.

200.description: name, denomination, coordinates, website where known, provenance

get.summary: Upcoming PUBLIC Christian gatherings (worship, prayer, Bible study, services) listed on The Living Bread, as schema.org-like events. A gathering that hides its address hides its city too.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name or slug.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO code or name.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: service, study, outreach, prayer or other.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Window in days, 1 to 180, default 30.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1 to 200, default 50.

200.description: count and items with title, starts_at, status, url, source

get.summary: Verified needs from ministries that ask for people to serve. City and country only, never coordinates.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City.

200.description: items with title, ministry, city, url

get.summary: How many distinct people prayed through The Living Bread in a window (counts only, never names).

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: 1 to 168, default 24.

200.description: people, countries (three or more people), as_of

get.summary: Today's Daily Bread verse (KJV), people who prayed in the last hour, and the next public gathering.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Optional city for the next gathering.

200.description: date, bread { ref, text, translation }, prayed_last_hour, next_gathering
